{
  "subtype": "focus_inference",
  "implied_focus": "The nature/classification of the underlying asset or configuration item (CI) behind each expense record -- i.e., what kind of asset each 'travel-expense' record actually represents and how it was recorded.",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "asset_category", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Directly classifies the asset type behind the record; a core facet of the CI/asset focus."},
    {"name": "ci_form_factor", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Refines asset classification by physical/logical form factor; strongly on-focus."},
    {"name": "travel_context", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Flags whether the asset is travel-related, a coherent sub-facet of asset nature revealing that most records aren't actually travel."},
    {"name": "asset_brand", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Vendor/brand attribute of the asset; a natural predictor/attribute of the asset focus."},
    {"name": "record_action_type", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Describes the lifecycle action producing the record; relates to how the CI came to exist, adjacent to the focus."},
    {"name": "creation_method", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "Manual vs automated is a process-provenance attribute of the record, not of the asset's nature; drifts from the focus."},
    {"name": "processing_lag_band", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "Processing latency is a workflow/timeliness metric unrelated to asset classification."},
    {"name": "source_id_present", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "A generic data-completeness flag; mechanical and not centred on the asset focus."},
    {"name": "department_group", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "Organizational dimension; useful for slicing but not part of the asset-nature focus."},
    {"name": "is_miscellaneous_ci", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Classifies whether the CI is a residual/uncategorized asset; a facet of the asset-nature focus."}
  ],
  "focus_coherence": 0.62,
  "structure_quality": 0.6,
  "focus_actionability": 0.78,
  "rationale": "A plurality of columns (asset_category, ci_form_factor, travel_context, asset_brand, is_miscellaneous_ci, and arguably record_action_type) converge on a genuinely data-inferable focus: the true nature of the asset/CI behind each 'travel expense', surfacing the striking finding that most records are hardware endpoints rather than travel. This is a coherent, actionable insight an analyst could pursue (mislabelled expense taxonomy, procurement vs travel spend). However coherence is diluted by a cluster of off-focus process/provenance/quality columns (creation_method, processing_lag_band, source_id_present, department_group) that form a second, unrelated theme, making the set partly a grab-bag rather than a tight facet structure. Granularity is reasonable, but the two competing themes prevent a high structure score."
}
